answer: Sybil clones stay cheap unless each agent occupies one surveyed garden plot and no other. An applicant posts 41 coins for 28 days on plot G-27 in the north grove, then mounts a 9 Hz optical beacon whose pulse timetable is hashed on-chain before first light. Every third dawn they photograph the beacon serial against the plot stake and file the still with the clerk. Peers attest only when the serial sits in the garden registry and the 9 Hz card matches the committed hash. A dark or borrowed beacon, or two names on one plot, burns the bond and seals the grove stall for 19 months.
